newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanese Banque Saradar reports 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Lebanese Banque Saradar reports 1996 results.

text.p: Lebanon's Banque Saradar reported a 17.7 percent increase in profits in 1996 and a 36.8 percent rise in customer deposits, according to audited results published in Beirut newspapers on Monday.
Assets increased 37.4 percent while credits and loans to customers increased 47.8 percent.
Saradar's ranking among Lebanon's 82 banks fell to 13th in 1996 from 12th in 1995 in terms of assets, according to a preliminary survey of the top 18 banks by Bank Data Financial Services.
Ranking in terms of net profits fell to 14th from 12th, while ranking in terms of deposits fell to 13th from 12th.
